trap.label: preposição + whom
trap.wrong: Farmers for who water was a worry moved away.
trap.right: Farmers for whom water was a worry moved away.
trap.why: Em português dizemos “para quem”/“os quais” e muitos reduzem para who. Depois de preposição, em inglês formal, a forma é whom.

opts: the town in which the flood struck
the town in that the flood struck
the town where in the flood struck

fix.wrong: Calder, who research changed policy, spoke.
fix.right: Calder, whose research changed policy, spoke.

fix.wrong: A team most of who were volunteers.
fix.right: A team, most of whom were volunteers.

fix.wrong: The spring flood that damaged the town it was severe.
fix.right: The spring flood that damaged the town was severe.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “I met farmers. Water was a worry for them.” (for whom)
rewrite.answer: I met farmers for whom water was a worry.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “She has a team. Most of the team were volunteers.” (most of whom)
rewrite.answer: She has a team, most of whom were volunteers.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “Calder is an ecologist. Her research changed policy.” (whose)
rewrite.answer: Calder is an ecologist whose research changed policy.
